Fall in love with the soulful melody of "Tenu Vekhi Jaavan", beautifully sung by Shahid Mallya and Asees Kaur. Featuring Himansh Kohli & Shivani Jadhav, this romantic Punjabi track is composed by Bharat Goel, with heartfelt lyrics by Rashmi Virag, making it a perfect song for every love playlist.

#TenuVekhiJaavan #ShahidMallya #AseesKaur #HimanshKohli #PunjabiSongs #LatestPunjabiSongs #PunjabiLoveSong #RomanticSong #LyricalVideo #TimesMusic

Watch the official Lyrical Video and enjoy every heartfelt lyric of this beautiful romantic song.
